name: ai.adeno.doom-engine
description: doomgeneric — id Software's Doom (shareware episode; engine GPL-2.0) running as a Uracil service. Renders 320x200 as ANSI truecolor half-blocks; all file I/O, timing and console output are serviced by the microkernel.

functions.name: doom_start
functions.description: Initialize the engine against doom1.wad from the service directory.

functions.name: doom_tick
functions.description: Advance the engine one frame (uses the platform clock).

functions.name: doom_key
functions.description: Deliver a key event (no platform requirements).

functions.name: doom_frame
functions.description: Return the latest framebuffer as ANSI text.
